subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice routing options and exception handling
messages:
From: Harper Cole <harper@sunburst.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding & invoice routing for Sunburst

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the kickoff call earlier — following up on next steps for activating Sunburst in Redwood's supplier ledger. We have a couple of operational constraints on our side and want to confirm the path of least friction for invoices. Quick context: we currently run Coupa for PO issuance and our ERP expects either an EDI/portal integration or emailed invoices keyed to PO numbers.

Questions we need answered before go-live:
- Do you require vendor portal onboarding (preferred by Redwood) or will you accept emailed invoices as a permanent option?
- If email, do you have a subject/filename convention we should follow so invoices auto-route to the right ledger entry?
- Does Redwood support PO stamping (matching incoming invoices to internal PO numbers) or do we need to include the PO on every line?
- Any fields in your minimal invoice template we should be aware of (VAT, supplier tax id, ship-to code, line-level SKU)?

I've attached our completed vendor onboarding form and a sample invoice with our typical line formatting. If email is required as a fallback, we can generate invoices from Coupa with a custom subject, but we'd prefer a programmatic option (SFTP/EDI) if that's supported.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Harper
Harper Cole
Finance Operations Manager
Sunburst Inc.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (filled), sample_invoice_lines.xlsx (example lines)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Harper Cole <harper@sunburst.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice routing for Sunburst

Hi Harper — thanks for the form and the sample. Short answers up-front: we prefer portal/EDI for scale but we do support emailed invoices as a documented fallback. A few clarifying points so we can finalize the onboarding checklist: 

1) Preferred path: Redwood supports Coupa punchouts / EDI feeds for large partners — we can hand you a vendor ID and integration guide. If you want that, I'll loop in our integrations team and provide the onboarding SLA (usually 2–3 weeks for Coupa connectors).

2) Email fallback: send invoices to invoices@redwood.com. For reliable auto-ingest please use this subject pattern: "RBW-INVOICE | Sunburst | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>" and attach a single PDF or CSV containing line items. Filenames are useful but subject tokens drive routing.

3) PO handling: we do PO stamping/matching on receipt. We prefer the PO number in the subject and as a top-level field on the invoice. If an invoice contains multiple POs, include a PO column on each line. If a single PDF contains multiple invoices, separate each with a cover page (or send individual attachments).

4) Minimal template: we require vendor name, vendor tax id, invoice number, invoice date, currency, total and line-level rows with description, qty, unit price, line net, tax amount, and PO number. VAT fields are optional for non-EU vendors but include tax breakdowns if applicable.

I've attached a compact sample CSV (redwood_compact_invoice_sample.csv) that our ingest team prefers for emailed fallbacks. If Coupa/EDI is an option, tell me and I'll start the connector request. Also looping in AP for final sign-off on exceptions.

Cheers,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_compact_invoice_sample.csv

From: Harper Cole <harper@sunburst.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & invoice routing for Sunburst

Marcus — thanks, the subject convention is straightforward and we can generate that from Coupa. A couple constraints to flag: 

- Our current Coupa instance will export single-invoice PDFs by default, and we can add the subject token via outgoing email template.
- SFTP/EDI is possible but will require an internal ticket; timeline about 4 weeks. Given our payroll & month-end cadence we'd prefer email fallback during Q3 ramp.
- Regarding multiple POs on one invoice: our finance ops usually avoid multi-PO invoices but there are cases (one shipping event billed to two POs). We can produce a CSV variant if you need line-level PO association.

I'll proceed with the templates on our side if AP is OK with the email fallback approach. Attaching an example Coupa-extracted CSV and a quick sample PDF.

Thanks,
Harper

- PO stamping: AP to confirm that we can match on subject token (RBW-INVOICE | Sunburst | PO:<PO>) and auto-apply. If we require PO on every line, state that so Harper can adjust export.
- Multi-PO invoices: accept if submitted as CSV with PO column per row; otherwise require split attachments.
- VAT / tax handling: any additional AP fields you need for EU vendors (not expected here but note for policy).
- Exception routing: propose that invoices missing PO go to APExceptions@redwood.com and vendors receive a 48-hour auto-reply with instructions to resubmit. Does that work?

Proposed timeline:
- Today: AP sign-off on email fallback rules.
- This week: Harper configures Coupa outgoing subject and test invoice to invoices@redwood.com (we'll confirm parsing with sample).
- 2–4 weeks: start connector ticket for Coupa/EDI if Sunburst wants full programmatic flow.

Action items (for clarity):
1) Vanessa confirm subject-token matching + PO stamping rules.
2) Monica confirm whether onboarding form from Harper is sufficient for vendor activation.
3) Harper to send a test invoice following "RBW-INVOICE | Sunburst | PO:12345 | INV:SB-001" to invoices@redwood.com.

Thanks — forwarding Harper's original attachments for visibility.

Thanks Marcus — AP is comfortable with the proposed approach with these concrete rules so Sunburst can go-live with email fallback: 

1) Required fields (email fallback & CSV): vendor name, vendor tax id, invoice number, invoice date, currency, invoice total, line rows with description, qty, unit price, net, tax, PO (per line). If vendor cannot add PO per line, we will accept a separate CSV mapping file tying line numbers to POs but it must be attached and referenced in subject.

2) Subject-token matching: yes — we will ingest based on the subject pattern you specified (RBW-INVOICE | Sunburst | PO:<PO_NUMBER> | INV:<INVOICE_NUMBER>). PO stamping will auto-match when PO is present. Missing PO -> route to APExceptions@redwood.com.

3) Multi-PO invoices: accept only via CSV with explicit PO column per row. PDFs with ambiguous multi-POs will be rejected and returned for split submission.

4) Exception SLA & auto-reply: we will send an automated 48-hour acknowledgement for any invoice missing required fields, with a link to our vendor help page and a request to resubmit.

5) Onboarding form: Monica confirms the attached vendor_onboarding_form.pdf is sufficient to create the vendor record; once record exists AP will assign vendor ID and update the connector ticket if they opt for Coupa/EDI.

Attached is our AP field mapping (ap_field_map.csv) with exact CSV headers and an exemplar line. Harper — please run a test to invoices@redwood.com by EOD Friday with subject: "RBW-INVOICE | Sunburst | PO:12345 | INV:SB-001". We'll confirm parsing and close the ticket.

Vanessa Ortiz
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
